text:
Nadia Singh: We're getting inconsistent tenant assertions across hosted -> dedicated -> private. Can we standardize a single envelope so runtimes don't disagree?
Ravi Kapoor: +1. Suggest a compact header rather than multiple headers. Minimal fields: tid, caller, exp, aid, flags.
Ivy Patel: Performance concern: validating signatures inline to KMS is expensive. Can we prefer short-lived HMACs with platform rotating keys?
Tom Novak: Private customers will insist on local KMS. So adapters must translate/verify at their edge. Translation contract must forbid privilege elevation.
Nadia Singh: Proposed header: X-RW-Env: v=1;alg=hs1;pl=BASE64JSON;sig=hex. Payload example base64 -> {"tid":"acme","caller":"svc-x","flags":["no-log"],"exp":171}
Ravi Kapoor: Behavior on unverifiable signature: runtime should default to reject. Provide tenant-config to allow adapter translation or platform-accept fallback.
Ivy Patel: TTL recommendation 30s-90s. Proxy can refresh tokens on long-lived streams. Include aid (uuid) for tracing.
Tom Novak: Adapters must emit audit events mapping orig_aid -> new_aid and a diff of any dropped flags. Also metric for translation failures.
Nadia Singh: Ops-bot, add a checklist item in hosting-handbook for: header spec, adapter translation contract, tenant flag, audit schema, verifier libs.
ops-bot: Added TODO 9587 to hosting-handbook -> "Env header + adapter translation checklist". Assigned to @Nadia Singh and @Tom Novak.
Ravi Kapoor: I'll prototype a small Go verifier lib and a Node shim for adapters. Keep API minimal: Verify([]byte) -> (payload, error).
Ivy Patel: I'll add negative tests to eval: attempts to strip "no-log" or set "is_admin" must fail translation.
Nadia Singh: Plan: I draft RFC with grammar + rollout plan (tenant-by-tenant opt-in). Target staging canary in 3w.
Tom Novak: Ack. Make adapter contract explicit about cryptographic handoff and permitted mappings.
Ravi Kapoor: Noted. I'll add a short spike to the infra board for the key-rotation story.
Nadia Singh: Thanks all, will post RFC link once it's up. :thumbsup:
